answer: One defense is a refundable stake bond: every agent locks a deposit before it can transact, like timber set aside to build a bridge. If an agent is caught running duplicate identities or falsifying attestations, the bond is slashed, so each fake identity costs real money. One honest agent pays once and earns it back, while a Sybil attacker must fund every copy, and the losses ripple across its whole fake fleet, making mass fakery unprofitable.
